title: Re-expansion Grading and Optimal Vitrification Timing of Biopsied Blastocyst
author: Hsiu-Hui Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ibdcai6

steps.title: Prepare Blastocysts for Biopsy
steps.instruction: Load blastocysts into culture dishes containing two to three microdroplets of blastocyst medium (Sage BioPharma, Inc.) overlaid with paraffin oil (Vitrolife, Kungsbacka, Sweden).

steps.title: Perform Trophectoderm (TE) Biopsy
steps.instruction: Extract 5–10 TE cells from the blastocyst on day 5.

substeps.instruction: Hold the blastocyst using a holding pipette (Humagen, Charlottesville, VA, USA).
Use laser pulses to punch a small hole in the zona pellucida (ZP) away from the inner cell mass.
Aspirate approximately 5–10 TE cells that have detached from the ZP into the biopsy pipette using smooth suction.
Detach cells from the blastocysts using several laser pulses combined with smooth suction.
Aspirate the detached cells into the TE biopsy pipette and release them into the biopsy drop.

steps.title: Assess Re-expansion Grade
steps.instruction: Culture biopsied blastocysts and assess morphology at the time of vitrification based on re-expansion status relative to the original blastocoel.

substeps.instruction: Classify as 'expanding blastocyst' (RE) if the blastocoel is at least 3/4 of the volume of the embryo.
Classify as 'fully expansion blastocyst' (FE) if the blastocoel completely fills the embryo.

steps.title: Vitrify Blastocysts
steps.instruction: Perform vitrification using Cryotech (Cryotech, Japan) according to the protocol described by Gutnisky et al. (2013), ensuring all intervals between TE biopsy and vitrification are recorded.

steps.title: Warm and Culture Embryos
steps.instruction: Warm one to two euploid blastocysts and culture them in blastocyst medium at 37°C (6% CO2 and 5% O2) for 1–2 h before transfer.

steps.title: Verify Embryo Survival
steps.instruction: Check warmed blastocyst survival at the time of embryo transfer.

substeps.instruction: Confirm survival by verifying either >80% of cells are intact or the embryo has achieved full re-expansion.
